name: comp-595

frames.best_why: The whole bar is visible at rest: back, title, three actions, three avatars with dots and +3.

tagline: Editor toolbar with a back arrow, page title and a row of online collaborators.
summary: A slim dark header for a shared document, holding a back chevron, the title Basic UI, three round icon actions for history, comments and adding people, and an avatar stack with presence dots.
appearance: A slim dark header with a back chevron, the title Basic UI, three round ghost icons (clock, comment, add person), then an avatar stack of three small photos with presence dots and a +3 circle.
behaviour: Hovering any icon, avatar or the +3 circle lightens its background; nothing else opens in the clip. The small dots under the photos mark which collaborators are online.
demo_content: The title reads Basic UI; avatars stand for Kelly King, Martha Johnson and Linda Green, with +3 more.
search_phrases: back button and page title header
use_when: A collaborative editor needs presence avatars and quick comment or history actions in one bar.
avoid_when: The avatar photos are hardcoded files, and the action buttons do nothing beyond a hover tint.
customise: Title, three avatar images, names and the +3 count are hardcoded; the icon buttons have no handlers, so actions need wiring.
weight_why: A title, four small buttons and three small avatars.

a11y.note: Buttons and avatars carry names, but the avatar group is not announced as a unit and the actions are inert.

issues: The comment icon button is labelled Save, so assistive tech announces the wrong action.
polish_why: Tidy collaboration bar with clear presence dots; the action buttons are only decorative here.
title: Collab Nav Header
